1.title: Top Democrats press Maine Senate candidate to drop out of race over sexual assault allegation
1.summary: Graham Platner denied the allegation, calling it "categorically false" but said he was "taking the time to reflect on the best path forward".

2.title: ICE Officer Kills a Mexican Man in Houston
2.summary: The agency said the man was an “illegal alien” who had tried to run over the agent, though no evidence was immediately offered.

3.title: These Maine Democrats Might Replace Graham Platner in the Senate Race
3.summary: Mr. Platner has not yet withdrawn from the race after a rape allegation, but Democrats in the state and nationally are already exploring potential alternatives.

4.title: Venezuelans Criticize Own Government Response After Twin Earthquakes
4.summary: Venezuelans are publicly expressing their anger over their government’s disaster response, despite the risk of imprisonment.

5.title: US launches strikes on Iran after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
5.summary: The US says the strikes are intended to impose "heavy costs", while Iran warns it will "take decisive measures" in response.

6.title: Le Pen Says She Will Run for Presidency After Court Lifts Ban
6.summary: An appeals court confirmed Marine Le Pen’s embezzlement conviction, but shortened a ban on her eligibility for elected office. That means the French far-right leader can run for president in 2027.
